sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_meta" ("lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "etag" TEXT NOT NULL, "dataset_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lang"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meals" ("lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "cuisine" TEXT NULL, "dish_form" TEXT NULL, "serving_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "servings" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carb_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "dataset_version" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lang", "meal_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_tags" ("lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lang", "meal_id", "tag"), FOREIGN KEY(lang, meal_id) REFERENCES meals(lang, meal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_allergens" ("lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lang", "meal_id", "code"), FOREIGN KEY(lang, meal_id) REFERENCES meals(lang, meal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_ingredients" ("lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ingredient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "grams_per_serving" REAL NOT NULL, "is_optional" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_optional" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("lang", "meal_id", "position"), FOREIGN KEY(lang, meal_id) REFERENCES meals(lang, meal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_nutrients" ("lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "per_100g" REAL NULL, "per_serving" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lang", "meal_id", "code"), FOREIGN KEY(lang, meal_id) REFERENCES meals(lang, meal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_steps" ("lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "text" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lang", "meal_id", "position"), FOREIGN KEY(lang, meal_id) REFERENCES meals(lang, meal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cuisines" ("lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("lang", "code"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_prefs" ("meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stance" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("meal_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_allergens" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "severity" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("plan_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "algorithm_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carb_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fiber_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "totals_kcal" REAL NULL, "totals_protein_g" REAL NULL, "totals_carb_g" REAL NULL, "totals_fat_g" REAL NULL, "totals_fiber_g" REAL NULL, "totals_saturated_fat_g" REAL NULL, "totals_sodium_mg" REAL NULL, "totals_sugars_g" REAL NULL, "kcal_within10pct" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("kcal_within10pct" IN (0, 1)), "solver_status" TEXT NULL, "kcal_relaxed" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("kcal_relaxed" IN (0, 1)), "solve_seconds" REAL NULL, "candidate_meals" INTEGER NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plan_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_items" ("plan_item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_date" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (plan_date) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "slot" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "meal_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "servings_multiplier" REAL NOT NULL, "grams" REAL NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carb_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "reason_codes" TEXT NOT NULL, "was_swapped" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("was_swapped" IN (0, 1)), "logged" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("logged" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("plan_item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_unmet_minimums" ("plan_date" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (plan_date) ON DELETE CASCADE, "nutrient" TEXT NOT NULL, "minimum" REAL NOT NULL, "total" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plan_date", "nutrient"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_windows" ("window_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot" TEXT NOT NULL, "start" TEXT NOT NULL, "end" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("window_date", "slot"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_summaries" ("summary_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_kcal" REAL NULL, "kcal" REAL NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carb_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "plan_items_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_items_consumed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NULL, "total_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL, "goal_ml" INTEGER NULL, "requires_clinician" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("requires_clinician" IN (0, 1)), "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("summary_date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_lists" ("range_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("range_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_items" ("range_key" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_lists (range_key) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ingredient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "grams" REAL NOT NULL, "meals" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checked" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("checked" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("range_key", "ingredient_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("op_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "op_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_uuid" TEXT NULL, "entity_ref" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("op_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "consumption_logs" ("client_uuid" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_log_id" INTEGER NULL UNIQUE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_item_id" INTEGER NULL, "meal_id" INTEGER NULL, "log_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot" TEXT NULL, "servings_consumed" REAL NULL, "consumed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carb_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("client_uuid"));
CREATE INDEX meals_lang_search_key ON meals (lang, search_key)
